tokens.name: paper-50
tokens.usage: Raised ground: icon squares, inputs, menus. One step lighter than the page.

tokens.name: paper-100
tokens.usage: The page ground. Everything sits on this unless it is a cobalt window.

tokens.name: paper-200
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: the quiet Button, code chips, skeleton blocks. Told apart from paper-100 by its label, not its edge (1.1:1, as in the source).

tokens.name: paper-300
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of paper-200 fills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: section rules, accordion and log dividers. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, checkboxes, outlined controls. 3:1 on paper-50 and paper-100.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on paper-50, paper-100, paper-200, paper-300 and cobalt-wash.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, tool arguments, descriptions on paper-50 through paper-300 and cobalt-wash.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Mono labels, durations, fine print on paper-50 and paper-100 only.

tokens.name: cobalt-300
tokens.usage: The light streak inside cobalt windows and the top of the footer fade. Decoration only: never put text on it.

tokens.name: cobalt-500
tokens.usage: The brand fill: primary Button, the footer fade's solid end. Text on it is on-cobalt.

tokens.name: cobalt-600
tokens.usage: The body of a cobalt WindowCard; hover of the primary Button. Text on it is on-cobalt.

tokens.name: cobalt-700
tokens.usage: Pressed primary Button; label ink of the inverse Button on on-cobalt.

tokens.name: cobalt-ink
tokens.usage: Cobalt as ink on paper-50, paper-100 and paper-200: the wordmark, links, hovered rows, halftone dots, the focus ring.

tokens.name: cobalt-wash
tokens.usage: A tinted ground for a selected or current row. Text on it is ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: on-cobalt
tokens.usage: Text and marks on cobalt-500, cobalt-600 and cobalt-700; the fill of the inverse Button; the focus ring inside a cobalt window.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: A positive result in a ToolLog (+18 drafts) and the passed status mark, on paper-50 and paper-100. Always paired with a check mark or a plus sign.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: A negative result in a ToolLog (-1 meeting) and the failed status mark, on paper-50 and paper-100. Always paired with a cross or a minus sign.

tokens.name: signal-red
tokens.usage: First of the three window dots on a WindowCard. Decoration: it never carries state.

tokens.name: signal-amber
tokens.usage: Second window dot. Decoration only.

tokens.name: signal-green
tokens.usage: Third window dot. Decoration only.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The one hero line of a page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.sample: Built for people with actual work to do

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Agents that do the work of a full team, and a way to build your own.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Prompts, skills and playbooks, built and tested on real work.
styles.usage: Default running text, accordion questions, link lists.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Agentic infrastructure and advisory for founders and teams.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, rule labels, column titles. Always uppercase.

styles.name: mono-body
styles.usage: ToolLog rows, inline code, terminal output.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: icon to label, dot to dot.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside small controls; the stipple grid's coarse pitch.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Small Button padding, gaps in a log row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button padding, the page gutter on phones, WindowCard chrome.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between related blocks; accordion row padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: WindowCard padding, column gaps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between a heading and its content; the footer stripe pitch.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between a visual and its text block.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections on small screens.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop. The page is meant to feel empty.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon squares, chips, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: WindowCards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Window dots and status marks.

shadow.note: One shadow, cobalt-tinted, for cobalt windows only. Paper surfaces stay flat.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Under a WindowCard so it floats off the paper.

halftone.note: The dot grid every Stipple illustration is drawn on.

tokens.name: dot-size
tokens.usage: Side of one square halftone dot.

tokens.name: dot-pitch
tokens.usage: Distance between dot origins. Keep dot-size at half of it.

meta.source: A single landing-page screenshot supplied by the owner. Colours were sampled from its pixels; sizes were measured from it and rounded. The Night theme is derived, not sourced.
